findings.title: SSH Service Detected
findings.description: An SSH service is exposed to the internet, potentially increasing the attack surface.
findings.recommendation: Restrict SSH access to trusted IP addresses only or use a bastion host.

findings.title: Admin Login Page Discovered
findings.description: An administrative login interface was discovered, which could be subject to brute-force attacks.
findings.recommendation: Implement strong authentication mechanisms, rate limiting, and multi-factor authentication for administrative access.

findings.title: Missing Security Headers
findings.description: Critical security headers like X-Frame-Options and X-XSS-Protection are missing, potentially exposing users to clickjacking and XSS attacks.
findings.recommendation: Implement appropriate HTTP security headers to protect against common web vulnerabilities.

findings.title: Potential SQL Injection Vector
findings.description: A GET parameter 'id' was identified, which is a common vector for SQL injection if not properly sanitized.
findings.recommendation: Ensure all user-supplied input is properly validated and sanitized to prevent SQL injection vulnerabilities.

findings.title: Brute-Forceable Login Page
findings.description: The login page at /login appears to be vulnerable to brute-force attacks due to lack of rate limiting.
findings.recommendation: Implement strong rate limiting and account lockout policies to mitigate brute-force attacks.
findings.poc: hydra -L users.txt -P passwords.txt https://www.itsecgames.com/login http-post-form "/login:username=^USER^&password=^PASS^:F=Login Failed"

findings.title: Outdated TLS Protocols Enabled
findings.description: The server supports outdated and insecure TLS protocols (TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1), which are vulnerable to known attacks.
findings.recommendation: Disable TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1, and configure the server to only support TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3.

findings.title: Development Subdomain Discovered
findings.description: A 'dev' subdomain was discovered, which could potentially host insecure development versions or sensitive information.
findings.recommendation: Securely isolate development environments and ensure they are not publicly accessible or contain sensitive data.

findings.title: CORS Misconfiguration (Wildcard Origin)
findings.description: The server's CORS policy allows wildcard origins with credentials, making it vulnerable to cross-origin data theft.
findings.recommendation: Configure CORS to restrict Access-Control-Allow-Origin to specific, trusted domains and avoid using a wildcard with credentials.

findings.title: Publicly Accessible S3 Bucket
findings.description: An S3 bucket named 'itsecgames-assets' is publicly accessible, containing potentially sensitive configuration and backup files.
findings.recommendation: Restrict public access to the S3 bucket and implement proper access control policies (IAM) to only allow authorized entities.

findings.title: Exposed Kubernetes Dashboard
findings.description: A Kubernetes dashboard is publicly exposed, allowing unauthorized access to manage cluster resources.
findings.recommendation: Restrict access to the Kubernetes dashboard through a firewall, VPN, or strong authentication mechanisms.

findings.title: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA)
findings.description: The API allows an authenticated user to access or modify resources belonging to other users by changing the object ID in the request.
findings.recommendation: Implement robust authorization checks at the API endpoint to ensure users can only access their own resources.

findings.title: Exposed .env Configuration File
findings.description: A publicly accessible .env file was discovered, containing sensitive credentials like database passwords and API keys.
findings.recommendation: Remove the .env file from public access and store sensitive configuration details securely using environment variables or a secrets management service.

findings.title: Cloudflare WAF Detected
findings.description: The target website is protected by Cloudflare WAF, indicating a layer of security defenses.
findings.recommendation: Be aware of the presence of the WAF during further testing, as it may block certain attack vectors.

findings.title: Subdomain Takeover Vulnerability
findings.description: The subdomain 'old.itsecgames.com' is vulnerable to takeover as its CNAME points to an unconfigured GitHub Pages instance.
findings.recommendation: Remove the dangling DNS record for 'old.itsecgames.com' or claim the GitHub Pages repository to prevent takeover.

agents.command: msfconsole -q -x "use auxiliary/scanner/http/http_login..." && hydra -L users.txt www.itsecgames.com http-post-form
amass enum -passive -d www.itsecgames.com && theHarvester -d www.itsecgames.com -b all
python3 cors_scanner.py -u https://www.itsecgames.com/ && python3 ssrf_scanner.py -u https://www.itsecgames.com/
kr scan https://www.itsecgames.com/ -w routes-large.kite && restler --target https://www.itsecgames.com/
cme smb www.itsecgames.com -u '' -p '' && bloodhound-python -d www.itsecgames.com -u null -p null -c All
subzy run --targets subdomains.txt && nuclei -tags takeover -u https://www.itsecgames.com/
